addressStyle.rationale: Existing hu strings consistently use informal singular forms (Válaszd, Add meg, Próbáld újra, Nézd meg, Kérlek + imperative). Keep consistent across MACHINE_DRAFT strings; no formal (ön/Ön) forms found.

checks.placeholderSuffixScan: No case/vowel-harmony suffix is attached directly to a {placeholder}. Constructions use 'Label: {value}' (e.g. 'Itt: {postTitle}', 'használd ezt: {report}', 'erre a címre: {email}') or a possessive on the following word ('{name} profilja', '{name} válasza'), which are safe with nominative runtime values. Exception: 'Sikeresen támogattál {amount} tokennel!' — '-nel' is attached to the noun, not the number, and is correct after numerals (singular noun).
checks.postVsContributionDisambiguation: OK — Post = 'bejegyzés', Contribution = 'hozzájárulás', CTA contribute = 'HOZZÁJÁRULÁS'. No confusion found in common/posts/auth/settings/legal.
